_note: Synthetic SRD-generic room for #157 (Kit II pr150d phrasings, no adventure text): a bunk room with straw beds that hold an unfound potion, a visible divination stone, a seam in the north wall, a tunnel mouth east and a short passage west.

bunks.name: Bunk room
bunks.arrival: Someone steps in among the beds.

labels.bunks: A low tunnel mouth in the east wall.
labels.tunnel: The way back to the bunk room.

beds.text: Heaps of filthy straw bedding line the south wall.

magic_objects.where: at the bottom of the east bed

potion.text: A small stoppered flask of ruby liquid lies buried in the east bed.

standing_stone.text: A waist-high standing stone carved with eyes stands at the north end.

handling.look: The carved eyes seem to follow you.

seam.text: A hairline seam in the north wall outlines a hidden door.

pit.text: A spiked pit lies under rotten boards just inside the tunnel mouth.

seam.truth: A seam in the north wall outlines a hidden door.

pit.truth: A spiked pit lies under the boards by the tunnel.
